header.description: Spell damage equations (FAM-10, stock): spell lookups and flags, damage and duration at a cast level, GetCurrentSpellMinMax and PullSpellEQ over the whole stock Spells table.
notes: Generated by tools/oracle/gen/spells.py. The case 'table' carries every stock Spells row (fields named in 'fields'; abilities as a flat [ability, value, ...] list without empty slots) so the Rust test needs no database.

Cases 'as-*', 'sn-*' and 'mn-*' call GetAbilityStats, GetSpellName and GetMonsterName directly; the Rust test compares ability_text's answers with them and runs PullSpellEQ over the real text port. Ability text for abilities other than 43/148/151/153 does not depend on the calc-level flag or bQuickSpell, so those are recorded once.
PullSpellEQ is always called with lv omitted (Nothing); the ListView rows it would add are UI and not ported.
